policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: SEC Form D filed for O Startup Fund II, L.P.
items.summary: SEC EDGAR shows a Form D filed with accession dated 2026-08-26 for O Startup Fund II, L.P., indicating an exempt securities offering activity tied to a fund entity.

items.headline: O: PORTS-Pike credits for Ohio students + NVIDIA/ SB Energy financing-linked build
items.summary: O announced an Ohio program providing up to $84M in Codex credits (2026–2027). It also described that lease payments start as capacity is available, with NVIDIA investing $1.5B in SB Energy for initial IT capacity buildout.

items.headline: G: $350M Series A values company at $3.5B
items.summary: G announced closing a $350M Series A, valuing the company at $3.5B, led by Disruptive with planned NVIDIA participation; it also cited $650M raised in June 2026 and a $1B total in recent funding.

items.headline: O: GPT-5.6 Luna/Sol become default/updated in ChatGPT
items.summary: O expanded August availability of updated GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Luna, moving free and paid tiers to new defaults/model options and continuing Preparedness Framework safeguards.
